surface: rc-agent OTA delivery + Windows registry/PowerShell deploy-edit
author: bono

two_distinct_paths.path_A_rc_agent_OTA_swap: the re-rollout mechanism — rc-sentry :8091/exec atomic kill+rename swap + staged HTTP download (deploy-server.sh v3.0 lineage)
two_distinct_paths.path_B_inline_ps_over_ssh: rotate-credentials.sh credential-rotation — the FAIL surface this RCA fixes; NOT used by the re-rollout

Q1_atomic_primitives.evidence: single /exec cmd.exe chain: taskkill /F /IM rc-agent.exe & del /Q rc-agent-prev.exe & ren rc-agent.exe rc-agent-prev.exe & ren rc-agent-<hash>.exe rc-agent.exe — one call, not a multi-step pipeline racing the watchdog

Q2_ttl_bounded_sentinels.evidence: OTA_DEPLOYING sentinel is written at start / cleared on complete|rollback but has NO TTL (PR-66 CF-2 class). Residual risk: a swap that dies mid-way strands the sentinel.
Q2_ttl_bounded_sentinels.mitigation: canary-one-pod-first contains blast radius to a single pod; manual sentinel clear documented

Q3_behavioral_verify.evidence: post-swap verify = build_id on :8090/health (== expected short-HEAD) + fleet/health ws+http + tasklist Session column == Console. Not echo-string, not exit-code.

Q4_single_target_dry_run.evidence: pod-8 canary-FIRST is the single-target path; bono verifies pod-8 behaviorally before authorizing pods 1,2,4,5,6,7 one-at-a-time (PR-66 CF — no-canary fleet-wide — is directly closed)

Q5_guard_contracts.evidence: rc-sentry /exec requires X-Service-Key (auth present, bono holds it). But no written parser-not-regex allowlist contract on /exec command bodies.
Q5_guard_contracts.mitigation: operator-authored exact command strings (no untrusted input); cmd.exe-hostile-quoting rules followed (PID/file-based targeting)

verdict_path_A: CONDITIONAL-PASS (3 YES / 2 PARTIAL) — re-rollout MAY proceed CANARY-FIRST. The 2 PARTIALs are the PR-66 residual classes; canary-first + behavioral-verify are the compensating controls that contain them to one pod. PARTIALs tracked as P2 hardening, NOT rollout blockers.
verdict_path_B: FAIL — inline-PS-over-SSH Set-Content (rotate-credentials.sh) violates Q1 (Git-Bash mangles PS vars) + Q3 (echo-as-success) + Q4 (no canary). FIXED in this RCA (P1): write-local-.ps1 -> SCP -> -File + --canary + read-back verify. New occurrences blocked by scripts/check-no-inline-ps-ssh.sh gate.
gate_decision: re-rollout GATE A: CLEARED for canary-first execution. Path-B fix + mechanical gate land with this RCA.
